test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the word from the options which is exactly opposite in meaning to the bracketed word given in the sentence below.**

Ruffin is seeking that (harmony) of humour in truth-telling amid despair.
solution: The correct answer is: **Discord** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Harmony **means agreement or compatibility. (सहमति या अनुकूलता) • **Example**:* In their relationship, they found a rare harmony, always supporting each other.* • Marked option **Discord **means disagreement or lack of harmony. (असहमति या सामंजस्य की कमी) • **Example**: *The heated argument caused discord among the team members.* • The opposite of a word can be found by identifying its antonym. • In this sentence, Ruffin is seeking humour in truth-telling amid despair, but he wants it to be discordant, not harmonious. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Conformity **means compliance or agreement with standards or rules. (मानकों या नियमों का अनुपालन या समझौता) • **Sectional **means relating to or concerning a particular section or group. (किसी विशेष वर्ग या समूह से संबंधित या उससे संबंधित) • **Determination **means firmness of purpose or resoluteness in achieving a goal. (किसी लक्ष्य को प्राप्त करने में उद्देश्य की दृढ़ता या दृढ़ संकल्प) 1b4:T57f, The correct answer is:"**it is, for the wind was**".
